  • Demonstrated experience developing scopes of work for improvement or shutdown projects.
  • Previous experience coordinating contractors within an industrial or mining environment.
  • Understanding of shutdown planning and scheduling processes.
  • Experience developing and maintaining Safe Work Instructions (SWIs) or similar safety documentation.
  • Strong understanding of procurement standards and contractor management processes.
  • Working knowledge of electrical and/or instrumentation systems.
Essential:
